pass_b_english: We will be conformed to the image of God's Son, and Paul preached that the saints will be conformed to the Son of God; how do you want to see the saints who will be glorified in glory, but are now in a state of dishonor, death, and silence, when the Lord says about them: 'they will be like angels of God' (Matthew 22:30)? How then do you worship angels, who are spirits and always living, as written by the prophet, 'he who makes his angels spirits and his ministers a flame of fire' (Psalm 104:4)? I say, however, that not even they themselves wish to be worshiped. 'See that you do not do this; for I am a fellow servant of yours and of your brothers who have the testimony of Jesus.
